thread:
alex: Quick ping — PR #11563 needs cross-team eyes for a hotfix to KV cache eviction. This showed up in Dedicated/private canaries (stale prefix stays in KV under rare preemption). Tests green locally and unit/integ CI passing. Need runtime + infra + security approvals to merge today so we can do a small canary tonight. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/pull/11563

alex: TL;DR: one-line fix in runtime/cache/evictor.cc, remove a premature early-return that skipped prefix cleanup when preempted. No model changes. Small k8s config bump for canary memory. Patch snippet:
```diff
- if (preempted) return;
+ if (preempted) { /* still run prefix cleanup */ }
```

maya: I can do runtime review now, will check perf + KV semantics. ping me if you want microbench numbers.

sam: infra question — I see a config tweak under deploy/manifests/evictor-canary.yaml, is that the memory bump? looks harmless but want to confirm rollout plan.

pranav: @alex can you confirm which customer cohorts this canary will hit? want to make sure no critical SLAs affected.

alex: canary will be 2 nodes in us-west-2, traffic routed only from internal test tenants + 10% of fresh signups. No high-SLA customers.

security-bot: static-scan: no secrets detected; dependency-check: low findings (non-blocking).

julia: quick sec question — does this change require any syscall / new caps or elevated fs access? if not I can do a fast review.

alex: no new binaries or caps, just runtime C++ change and a config tweak. No new IAM roles.

linh: infra note — suggest increasing eviction service memory in the canary from 512Mi -> 768Mi to avoid OOM if cache cleanup overlaps with heavier load. non-blocking for merge but prefer to land with that canary sizing.

maya: runtime LGTM. Left two tiny comments about a comment and a move of a small helper, not blocking. perf microbench shows no regression for 1k token seqs. :thumbsup:

julia: security LGTM, just a nit about log redaction in one debug line, not blocking. signing off.

sam: infra OK for canary with memory bump. I'll apply the updated manifest to the canary namespace after merge.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary rollout scheduled at 22:30 PT once merge + CI finish. Oncall will be notified.

alex: awesome — thanks all. I'll merge after final CI. If anything pops during canary we can rollback quickly. Appreciate the quick cross-team reviews.
